summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd., an Israeli-based orthopedic biomaterials company listed on a US exchange, filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with XBRL tagging of prior-period comparative data. No transaction, corporate action, or control event is disclosed; the filing neither announces nor proposes an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, capital return, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as the US-equivalent interim report. No deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Risk-arb angle: none; monitor subsequent 6-K disclosures for financing or strategic developments.
